preconditions: this is a valid countdown-owning session/vehicle-state object; the function reads and writes fields at this+0x08 and this+0x3578..this+0x3A08.
a2 is an int step/state index; a2 == 0 requests a reset of the countdown sequence, a2 > 0 advances or re-enters a step.
If the byte at this+0x39EE is nonzero, the whole update body is skipped (guard gate).
postconditions: On a2 == 0 path: this+0x3A08 = 0, this+0x3A04 = 0, this+0x39F0 = 0 and the function returns.
On valid-step path (a2 <= step_index): countdown sound effect fired on this+0x08 object, this+0x3A04 reloaded from this+0x3A00.
On beyond-end path (a2 > step_index): countdown sound effect fired on this+0x08 object, this+0x3A04 reloaded from this+0x39FC.
If a2 == 1 and step_index == 0 on the beyond-end path: this+0x3A08 = 1, this+0x39F0 = 0, this+0x39EC = 1 and the function returns.
this+0x39EC is cleared to 0 at entry on every frame except when the a2==1/step_index==0 transition re-sets it to 1.
side_effects: Writes countdown state on this: byte 0x39EC (in-progress flag), dword 0x39F0 (step index), dword 0x3A04 (timer), dword 0x3A08 (phase).
Calls SoundEffectTrigger_89a0 (0x004F89A0) with argument this+0x08 on the valid-step path.
Calls SoundEffectTrigger (0x004F88A0, routed to packet sdk_expansion_r1_high_leverage_014) with argument this+0x08 on the beyond-end path.
Calls PositionUpdateWithTelemetryRecording (0x004EF4F0) with this when the green-light guard holds: a2 >= 1, float at 0x3578 > 0.0, float at 0x3978 > 0.0, and float at 0x3994 * 0.5 < float at 0x3998.
